testo:
Blocker
■ Whenever your opponent draws, if it's not the first card your opponent drew this turn, your opponent chooses a card from their hand and discards it.
■ Whenever you would draw a card for the first time each turn, you may draw 2 cards instead. If you do, discard a card from your hand.

■ 各ターン、自分がはじめてカードを引く時、1枚のかわりに2枚引いてもよい。そうしたら、自分の手札を1枚捨てる。
